MOTION Collective · house effects

FX Library

The effects we cut with, each one a stand-in for a plugin pro editors use in After Effects and Vegas, rebuilt in our own code so every video gets the same look. Each clip loops. The name under it is what to ask for.

20effects
127bpm grid
14.17frames per beat
1grade, every shot

Finish

One grade on every shot. This is what makes phone footage read as film.

Motion

Moves that feel shot, not slid.

Transitions

Hard cuts for 95% of edits. One of these per section, on a bar line.

Style

The AFTERIMAGE signatures.

The mark

Opens and closes every video.

Every cut needs a reason

MotionThe action carries across the cut. Cut a third into the move.
Eye-traceThe subject sits in the same third of the frame on both sides.
GraphicShape or brightness rhymes: a diagonal arm into diagonal beams.
MusicLands on a kick, a bar line or a phrase change.
StorySomething new arrives: the name, the eyes, the date.

The arc of a teaser

Beats 0–6

The mark flies in. Its exit zooms into the first shot.

Beats 6–14

Build. Cuts every 2, then every beat. Letterbox opens wider.

Beats 14–17

The name, one word per beat.

Beat 18

One beat of black in the dip.

Beat 19

Drop: the best image, full frame, impact shake.

Beats 25–27

One hero speed ramp. Hold it.

Beats 27–35

Eyes, name, date, the mark.

Teaser v4 · the cut list

BeatTimeShotWhy this cut
62.95 sclip bOut of the logo's fly-through: zoom-through lands on the widest, calmest shot (establish the room).
83.90 sclip aCut on action: the arm starts rising on the cut, motion hides the edit; frame opens wider.
104.84 sclip bPhrase line (bar 3): back to the booth, push in. Eye-trace stays centre.
125.78 sclip a1-beat cuts start: density up. Hands up again = motion match with b8.
136.26 sclip bKick on the 1: light flash in the source lands on the cut.
146.73 sword:iamHName, word 1 on the beat. Footage keeps moving inside the letters, so the energy carries.
157.20 sword:b2bWord 2: the red accent alone on black, the only colour in the build.
167.67 sword:rayHWord 3, then the cut density peaks.
178.15 sstutterHalf-beat alternations a/b: maximum tension in the last bar of the build.
188.62 sblackOne beat of black in the track's dip: the silence makes the drop hit.
199.09 sclip bDROP: best image on the drop frame (the room's own light hit), flash + impact shake, zoom settles.
209.56 sclip aGraphic match: the diagonal arm rhymes with the diagonal beams.
2110.03 sclip bCut on the kick, beams on the beat (in-sync source).
2210.51 sclip aShort close shot between two wides: rhythm of scale.
2310.98 sclip bBar line: the one designed transition in the drop, a zoom-through. Name lower third arrives.
2411.45 sclip bHands in the air, keep the crowd energy.
2511.92 sslowThe hero moment: one speed ramp only (fast -> 1/3 speed), heavy afterimage. Luxury holds once.
2712.87 seyesWhip into black, then the eyes open band by band on half-beats: the series signature.

Never: preset transitions on every cut, a flash or glow on every cut, red tints or RGB-split fringes, wave warps, bouncing or multi-coloured type. Those read as CapCut, or as trippy.

The crew

RoleWhoDoes
Creative directorJovanniTaste, music, the never-list, the final yes on everything that goes out.
Director / editorClaude CodeThe cut list with a reason per cut, 2–3 variants per teaser, keeps the bible current.
VFXClaude Code + this libraryPresets, the logo, the sting, the low-res treatment.
Reference scoutGeminiWatches references on YouTube and Instagram and describes mood, shots and pacing. It samples about 1 frame a second, so it can't time cuts.
Measurementffmpeg + ClaudeCut detection, shot lengths, cuts per bar, contact sheets.
VideographerA person with a cameraReal moves, light, 60/120 fps for slow motion. Capture fixes what no upscaler can.
CollectOne sheet, one row per reference: link, timestamp, why, tags.
AnalyseGemini describes it, ffmpeg measures it.
EncodeNew presets here, new rules in the bible.
Make2–3 variants per teaser.
ReviewJovanni scores each 1–5: expensive, on-beat, readable, red used right.
LearnEvery 2 weeks, keep what scored 4–5. Every correction becomes a rule.
